description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/require_gh20577.t puts a CODE ref in @INC that hands `require` a
filehandle over an in-memory string (the FatPacker shape) and then checks
%INC's entries and that the same object is in @INC afterwards.  All five rows
fail.

This is #1815 exactly -- `%p-inc-dir-file` calls `namestring` on every @INC
element, so a CODE ref / ARRAY ref / blessed object leaks a raw host error --
seen from a second file.  #1815 already carries op/inccode.t (76 rows) and
op/require_errors.t (17); add these 5 to its count.

Rule 12 first: announce and SKIP a non-string @INC element rather than calling
`namestring` on it.  That alone does not pass these rows (they need the hook to
be CALLED), but it stops the raw error.
subject: An @INC HOOK that returns a FILEHANDLE (the FatPacker shape) -- the #1815 family (op/require_gh20577.t, 5 rows)
